items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: There was a comedian-dancer there... "Open the door, Richard." Sandy Burns.

ctx.x: Yes. What were some of those shows that Eubie was playing at that time?
Well, I remember, like, Sarah (?), Ida Cox, a comedian-dancer... I don't remember the comedian's name. There was a comedian-dancer there... "Open the door, Richard." Sandy Burns.
